newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS SEE AEX PUSH ABOVE 820.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS SEE AEX PUSH ABOVE 820.

text.p: Dutch chartists questioned were
all upbeat about the short-term prospects for the AEX index this
week, with next resistance at around 825.
The AEX index ended at 803.96 on Friday, 9.66 points above
the previous Friday, just back from the high of 807.98 seen on
Thursday.
In the week before that the index had gained 13.49 points.
By midsession on Monday, the index had already passed 810
points.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ING Barings -- Price pattern of the AEX and its quality
indicators provide contradictory signals. The AEX is moving in
unchartered territory, but there is still no confirmation on the
momentum indicators. Money flow is still topping a bit, and
market momentum remains flat. This signals some selling pressure
coming in at higher levels. On the other hand, we saw last week
the price returning in its rising trend channel. This has
improved the market's technicals again. The trend channel offers
support around 790 and resistance around 825. The A/D line,
measuring market breadth, has resumed its strong rising trend,
indicating that leadership has returned in the market.
Another positive is a low reading of the 12-day call/put
ratio, which as a contrary indicator shows us that the majority
of traders and speculative market players is still "under
weighted" in the market. All in all, we return to a mildly
bullish stance with an intermediate objective around 825.
JAAD -- Uptrend intact. Watch out for small negative
divergence in RSI (could signal a small countertrend).
Rabo Securities -- The AEX did reach the price target at
808-810 and is still trading in that newly formed rising trend
channel. We still expect the AEX to continue its uptrend within
the boundaries of this trend channel. The upper boundary is now
at approximately 825, so there is still upward potential.
